source: GROUND.md §6-7. Numbers from hollow-orbit js/game/items.js (tool damage and gather rates, clothing protection, consumables, stack sizes) and RustMVP inventory_survival.md (stack sizes); arrows, bow, spears and berries use Rust's numbers. G4: firearms, rounds and attachments get their numbers from weapons.json (their stack of 128 and the guns' magazines from RustMVP, condition per shot from hollow-orbit's dur: pistol 200, rifle 300); the metal mask is hollow-orbit's metal_facemask (50% against shots and blows to the head). Names are ours. IDs are stable: never reuse a retired one (saves and the wire use them). Building items (G3, 100-110): "building" says what each does with building.json, a door item names its door there; a key's condition holds the number of the lock it was cut for. G5 (120-127): the explosives and the raiding weapons, Rust's stack sizes (charges and grenades 10, rockets 3, explosives 100); their blasts are in explosives.json and weapons.json. IW4 (128): the incendiary rocket (IRON_WAKE.md §7), a launcher round like the others, stack 3 as Rust's; its burst and its fire are in explosives.json. Ships (G6, 140-141): the vehicle workbench, and the Tin Finch, a ship (ships.json) rather than something carried. G7 (150-171, world.json): salvage (our scrap, the currency, stack 1000 as Rust's), the components (Rust's stack sizes), the two schematics (Rust's blueprint fragments), the blueprint (its condition holds the recipe it teaches, as a key's holds its lock) and the research table. G7 animals (200-216, GROUND.md §6.9): raw, cooked and burnt meat of the four kinds (Rust's food values where the Facepunch wiki has them: raw venison 20 calories and 10 poison, cooked 40 calories, 3 water, 10 healing; burnt 10 and 2; cooked wolf meat 60, 1, 5; raw bear meat 10, 3 water, 5 poison, cooked 100; ours for pork and the rest), cooking 15 s on a campfire (Rust) and burning 45 s later (ours); hide, bone fragments and animal fat; the bone knife (Rust's 16 damage and reach 1.5) and bone club (ours). 220 is taken by the second lamp-oil recipe (recipes.json) and is never an item.

actions.label: USE
actions.note: GROUND_SYSTEMS.md §7: the inventory's buttons, each done by one handler in Hollow.Simulation (Items/ItemActions.cs) for the part that offers it. Append only: an action's place here is its number on the wire. {item} in a label names what it acts on. USE: medicine (a consumable that doesn't feed).

actions.label: EAT
actions.note: Food: a consumable with calories or water.

actions.label: WEAR
actions.note: Clothing, into the clothing slot that takes it.

actions.label: UNEQUIP
actions.note: Clothing off, into the main slots, then the belt.

actions.label: LEARN
actions.note: A blueprint: its recipe is learnt and the blueprint used up.

actions.label: UNLOAD
actions.note: A firearm's rounds back into the inventory.

actions.label: REMOVE {item}
actions.note: An attachment off a firearm; its argument is the attachment's slot.

items.name: Wood
items.description: Chopped from trees. Builds, crafts and burns.

items.name: Stone
items.description: Broken from stone outcrops. Stone tools, furnaces and stone buildings.

items.name: Metal ore
items.description: Smelt it in a furnace for metal fragments.

items.name: Sulphur ore
items.description: Smelt it in a furnace for sulphur.

items.name: High-grade ore
items.description: A rich vein in metal outcrops. Smelt it for refined metal.

items.name: Metal fragments
items.description: Basic metal for tools, armour and workbenches.

items.name: Sulphur
items.description: Kept for powder and explosives.

items.name: Refined metal
items.description: Strong metal for armour and the better workbenches.

items.name: Charcoal
items.description: Left over when wood burns in a fire or furnace.

items.name: Plant fibre
items.description: Pulled from fibre plants. Clothing, bandages, bags and bows.

items.name: Lamp oil
items.description: Rendered from charcoal and fibre. A furnace needs some to be built.

items.name: Gunpowder
items.description: Charcoal and sulphur, ground together. Every round of ammunition needs some.

items.name: Rock
items.description: A fist-sized rock. Knocks wood off trees and stone off outcrops; better than nothing in a fight.

items.name: Torch
items.description: Light in the dark. A poor tool and a poor weapon.

items.name: Stone Axe
items.description: A sharpened stone on a handle. Chops trees.

items.name: Stone Pickaxe
items.description: A pointed stone on a handle. Breaks stone and ore.

items.name: Metal hatchet
items.description: A forged blade. Chops trees fast.

items.name: Metal pickaxe
items.description: A forged pick. Mines stone and ore fast.

items.name: Wooden spear
items.description: A long sharpened pole. Reaches further than anything else in hand.

items.name: Stone spear
items.description: A wooden spear with a stone point.

items.name: Machete
items.description: A long forged blade. Quick cuts that bleed.

items.name: Bow
items.description: Hold the right mouse button to draw, click to loose an arrow. Arrows drop with distance.

items.name: Service pistol
items.description: A semi-automatic pistol with a 15-round magazine. One shot a click; it kicks straight up. Takes a sight, a muzzle attachment and a light.

items.name: Frontier rifle
items.description: A fully automatic rifle with a 30-round magazine. Its recoil follows the same pattern every burst: learn it and pull against it.

items.name: Arrow
items.description: A fletched shaft. Often survives a miss.

items.name: Pistol rounds
items.description: Ammunition for the service pistol.

items.name: High-velocity pistol rounds
items.description: Faster and flatter than plain pistol rounds, a little weaker.

items.name: Incendiary pistol rounds
items.description: Slow rounds that set what they hit burning.

items.name: Rifle rounds
items.description: Ammunition for the frontier rifle.

items.name: High-velocity rifle rounds
items.description: Faster and flatter than plain rifle rounds, a little weaker.

items.name: Incendiary rifle rounds
items.description: Slow rounds that set what they hit burning.

items.name: Holo sight
items.description: A reflex sight: a little magnification and tighter shots aimed down the sights.

items.name: 4x scope
items.description: Four times magnification for the rifle. Very tight shots when aimed.

items.name: Silencer
items.description: Hides the muzzle flash and quiets the shot. Less recoil and spread; slower, weaker rounds.

items.name: Weapon light
items.description: A light under the barrel, lit while the gun is in hand.

items.name: Muzzle brake
items.description: Halves the recoil, but the shots spread wider and hit a little softer.

items.name: Bandage
items.description: Stops bleeding and heals a little over time.

items.name: Medical injector
items.description: Heals at once and over time, and stops bleeding.

items.name: Red berries
items.description: Sweet and filling. A little food and water, and they help a wound heal.

items.name: Blue berries
items.description: Juicy. More water than food.

items.name: Wild tuber
items.description: Edible raw, but roast it on a campfire and it is a meal.

items.name: Roasted tuber
items.description: Hot and filling.

items.name: Woven hood
items.description: A hood of rough plant fibre.

items.name: Woven shirt
items.description: A rough shirt. Keeps you a little warmer.

items.name: Woven trousers
items.description: Rough trousers.

items.name: Woven gloves
items.description: Keeps your hands warm.

items.name: Work boots
items.description: Fibre boots with metal-shod soles.

items.name: Chest plate
items.description: Riveted metal plates over the chest, worn on top of a shirt.

items.name: Metal mask
items.description: A welded mask over the face and the crown of the head. Halves what a hit to the head does.

items.name: Sleeping bag
items.description: Place it and you can come back here after you die, every five minutes.

items.name: Bed
items.description: A frame and a mattress. You can come back here after you die, every two minutes.

items.name: Campfire
items.description: Burns wood for warmth and charcoal, and cooks food.

items.name: Furnace
items.description: Burns wood to smelt ore into metal and sulphur.

items.name: Small box
items.description: A wooden box with room for 18 stacks.

items.name: Large box
items.description: A big wooden box with room for 48 stacks.

items.name: Workbench, level 1
items.description: Crafts level 1 items within 4 metres of it.

items.name: Workbench, level 2
items.description: Crafts level 2 items within 4 metres of it.

items.name: Workbench, level 3
items.description: Crafts level 3 items within 4 metres of it.

items.name: Building plan
items.description: Places twig building pieces. Hold the right mouse button to pick a piece.

items.name: Hammer
items.description: Upgrades, repairs, turns and demolishes building pieces. Hold the right mouse button for the choices.

items.name: Tool Cupboard
items.description: Claims the land around a building: only those it lists may build there. Keep it stocked to pay the upkeep.

items.name: Key lock
items.description: Locks a door. Its owner opens it, and so does anyone with a key cut for it.

items.name: Code lock
items.description: Locks a door with a four-digit code. Whoever enters the code may pass.

items.name: Key
items.description: Opens the key lock it was cut for.

items.name: Wooden door
items.description: Fits a doorway. Cheap, and burns.

items.name: Sheet metal door
items.description: Fits a doorway. Strong.

items.name: Armoured door
items.description: Fits a doorway. The strongest door there is.

items.name: Sheet metal double door
items.description: Fits a wall frame.

items.name: Garage door
items.description: Fits a wall frame and rolls up out of the way.

items.name: Explosives
items.description: A stable blasting compound. Timed charges and rockets are made from it.

items.name: Timed charge
items.description: Sticks to whatever it is placed on or thrown at, and goes off ten seconds later. Two break a stone wall.

items.name: Bag charge
items.description: A bag of powder with a fuse. It sticks where it lands; the fuse burns six to twelve seconds and sometimes goes out. Press E on a dud to light it again.

items.name: Tin grenade
items.description: A tin of powder with a short fuse. Throw it: it bounces, rolls and goes off about four seconds later, unless it fizzles.

items.name: Rocket launcher
items.description: Fires one rocket at a time and is slow to reload. Rockets fall over distance: aim high for far targets.

items.name: Rocket
items.description: Slow and heavy: it drops over distance, so aim high for far targets. Explodes where it hits. Four break a stone wall.

items.name: High-velocity rocket
items.description: Twice as fast and much flatter, with a small blast: made for people, not walls. Whoever it strikes dies, bears too.

items.name: Explosive rifle rounds
items.description: Rounds that burst where they hit: weaker against people, but they chip away at walls and doors.

items.name: Incendiary rocket
items.description: A small burst, then a pool of burning fuel for eighteen seconds: it sets people alight and burns wooden boxes, doors, twig and wood. Stone and metal don't burn; water puts it out.

items.name: Vehicle Workbench
items.description: A heavy bench with a hoist and a parts rack. Unlock spacecraft with salvage, then assemble them here. A finished ship rolls out onto the ground in front of it.

items.name: Tin Finch
items.description: A one-seat salvage skiff: a pressure cabin, three rear exhausts and four lift nozzles. Burns lamp oil. Built at a vehicle workbench.

items.name: Iron Wake
items.description: A 58 m carrier: an open construction deck behind a stern ramp, a glazed bridge, two siege batteries and four defense mounts. Burns lamp oil. Crewed, not built: there is no recipe yet.

items.name: Salvage
items.description: Scrap metal, wire and broken parts picked out of barrels, crates and old machines. Everyone takes it: the recycler pays in it, and workbenches, research and the tech tree cost it.

items.name: Gears
items.description: A handful of toothed wheels out of an old gearbox. Heavy doors need them. The recycler turns them into salvage and metal.

items.name: Springs
items.description: Coiled steel springs. A rifle's action is built round them.

items.name: Metal pipe
items.description: A length of seamless steel pipe: barrels for guns, tubes for rockets.

items.name: Rope
items.description: Plant fibre twisted into rope, strong enough to hold a load.

items.name: Cloth
items.description: A bolt of rough cloth woven from plant fibre.

items.name: Sewing kit
items.description: Needles, thread and patches in a tin.

items.name: Tech scrap
items.description: Circuit boards and broken electronics. Sights and timed charges need what is on them.

items.name: Metal blade
items.description: A blade of spring steel from a saw or a machine.

items.name: Sheet metal
items.description: A flat sheet of pressed steel.

items.name: Sign plate
items.description: A dented steel sign from a road long gone.

items.name: Gun receiver
items.description: The frame of a semi-automatic gun, the part its slide and barrel fit on.

items.name: Rifle frame
items.description: The receiver and stock of a military rifle, without its barrel and springs.

items.name: Torn schematic
items.description: Part of an engineering drawing, found in crates. A level 2 workbench needs three.

items.name: Sealed schematic
items.description: A whole drawing in a sealed sleeve, from military crates. A level 3 workbench needs three.

items.name: Blueprint
items.description: Use it to learn how to make the item it shows. Once learnt, you can craft it whenever you have the materials.

items.name: Research Bench
items.description: Takes an item apart to learn how it is made. Put the item and salvage in and start: a blueprint comes out.

items.name: Engineering Workbench
items.description: A precision assembly bench with its own technology tree, independent of standard workbench levels.

items.name: Raw venison
items.description: Deer meat. Eaten raw it makes you sick: cook it on a campfire.

items.name: Cooked venison
items.description: Lean and good, and it helps a wound heal. Take it off the fire before it burns.

items.name: Burnt venison
items.description: Charred. A little food, and a sore stomach.

items.name: Raw pork
items.description: Boar meat. Cook it before you eat it.

items.name: Cooked pork
items.description: Rich and filling. Take it off the fire before it burns.

items.name: Burnt pork
items.description: Black on the outside and not much better inside.

items.name: Raw wolf meat
items.description: Tough, dark meat. Raw, it makes you sick.

items.name: Cooked wolf meat
items.description: Stringy but filling. Take it off the fire before it burns.

items.name: Burnt wolf meat
items.description: Charred and bitter.

items.name: Raw bear meat
items.description: A lot of meat from one animal. Cook it.

items.name: Cooked bear meat
items.description: The best meal in the wild. Take it off the fire before it burns.

items.name: Burnt bear meat
items.description: A waste of a good bear.

items.name: Hide
items.description: Skinned from animals. Kept for leather goods.

items.name: Bone fragments
items.description: Broken bone from a carcass. Bone tools and weapons.

items.name: Animal fat
items.description: Rendered with a little fibre it makes lamp oil.

items.name: Bone knife
items.description: A sharpened shard of bone. Quick to cut, and the best tool for butchering a carcass.

items.name: Bone club
items.description: A heavy thigh bone with a knob at the end. Hits hard for something so simple.
